name: Heron's formula
whenToUse: You know all three side lengths of a triangle but no height or angle.
pitfall: Use the SEMI-perimeter, half of the perimeter. Also try to spot a shortcut first: the $13$-$14$-$15$ triangle is two right triangles $(5, 12, 13)$ and $(9, 12, 15)$ glued along the height $12$.
